body:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ INACTIVITY HAS CONSEQUENCES. ⚠️

Phantom Bloodline is built on loyalty, commitment and activity. We recognise the members who put time into P-B, but we will not allow inactivity to hold the crew back.

📋 RECENT CREW CHANGES

⬆️ SOLDIER → ASSOCIATE
• P-B x 2 Steine 2 Beine
• P-B x Зенокс™

❌ REMOVED DUE TO INACTIVITY
• P-B x Dufka
• P-B x ACE
• P-B x atlasrisee
• P-B x daddy dom
• P-B x Makarov
• P-B x Mouse_ST
• P-B x Mr.Khaleed
• P-B x Sansar Salvo
• P-B x strawberry bon bons

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔴 THE MESSAGE IS SIMPLE: STAY ACTIVE.

Being part of P-B means more than wearing the tag. It means showing up, getting involved, supporting your members and contributing to the crew.

No activity = no progression.
No commitment = no place guaranteed.

We understand that real life comes first. If you're going to be away, communicate with staff rather than disappearing without a word.

Promotions are earned. Respect is earned. Your place in Phantom Bloodline depends on the commitment you show.

🩸 STAY ACTIVE. STAY LOYAL. STAY P-B.

PHANTOM BLOODLINE — WE MOVE FORWARD. 🔴⚫⚪

title: Phantom Bloodline Rank-Up 🩸
body:
"Power isn't given in these streets- it's forged in blood and proven in war." 🐺

Behind every powerhouse crew, there’s someone orchestrating the chaos from the shadows. **P-B | Areebo** hasn't just put in work; he helped build the foundation we stand on 🧱. Through heavy gunfire, high-stakes hits, and every corner we took over, he held the line and never backed down 💥.

"To wear the crown, you have to carry the weight." ⚔️

The time for rising through the ranks is over. Today, he steps up to take his rightful seat at the top of the empire as **Co-Founder 👑**. From this moment on, his voice moves the entire family ⚡.

"We don't follow the rules—we write them." 🕯️

Clear the block and raise your cups high 🥂. Respect the authority, honor the bond, and welcome your new **Co-Founder**, **P-B | Areebo**.

**The Phantom Bloodline**

title: Phantom Bloodline Rank-Up 🩸
body:

*For months, **P-B | Twizzy** has walked beside the family 🤝 with unshakable **loyalty**. Through every storm 🌪️ he stood firm, through every trial ⚔️ he showed heart. His actions spoke louder than words, proving his worth time and time again ⏳.*

> *"A man who keeps his word is worth more than gold."* – 💎

*Today, the family honors that loyalty. twizzy has earned the title of **Boss** 👑 and with it, his place among the **Staff Team** ⚡.*

> *"It’s not the suit that makes the man 🤵, it’s the man who makes the family stronger."*

*Raise your glasses 🥂, brothers and sisters — for a man who rose through loyalty, respect, and unbreakable will. Welcome, **Boss twizzy**.*

> ***The Phantom Bloodline***
